functions.name: vr::IsRoleAllowedAsHand
functions.description: Utility that returns true if a tracked controller role is considered a hand (Left, Right, or Invalid). Intended to gate logic that treats a device role as a hand-held controller.
requirements: Input eRole must be a value of vr::ETrackedControllerRole.

functions.name: vr::ButtonMaskFromId
functions.description: Returns a bit mask with the bit for the given controller button ID set. Useful for testing vr::VRControllerState_t::ulButtonPressed/ulButtonTouched bitfields.
requirements: Input id must be a value of vr::EVRButtonId.

functions.name: vr::IsOpenXRAppType
functions.description: Returns true if the provided application type is one of the OpenXR types (OpenXRInstance, OpenXRScene, or OpenXROverlay).
requirements: Input eType must be a value of vr::EVRApplicationType.

functions.name: vr::BAppTypeSubmitsEyeBuffers
functions.description: Returns true if the specified application type is expected to submit eye buffers (Scene, OpenXRScene, or RoomView).
requirements: Input eType must be a value of vr::EVRApplicationType.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetRecommendedRenderTargetSize
functions.description: Outputs the recommended width and height for the intermediate render target that lens distortion pulls from. Call once at startup or when HMD/display configuration changes.
requirements: pnWidth must be a valid, writable pointer.
pnHeight must be a valid, writable pointer.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetProjectionMatrix
functions.signature: virtual vr::HmdMatrix44_t vr::IVRSystem::GetProjectionMatrix(vr::EVREye eEye, float fNearZ, float fFarZ) = 0
functions.description: Returns a projection matrix for the specified eye given near and far clip planes. Use to build the view-projection for rendering.
requirements: eEye must be Eye_Left or Eye_Right.
fNearZ and fFarZ should be positive and fNearZ < fFarZ (inferred from typical projection usage).

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetProjectionRaw
functions.signature: virtual void vr::IVRSystem::GetProjectionRaw(vr::EVREye eEye, float *pfLeft, float *pfRight, float *pfTop, float *pfBottom) = 0
functions.description: Outputs the raw tangents needed to build a projection matrix manually (e.g., for custom/infinite-Z projections).
requirements: eEye must be Eye_Left or Eye_Right.
pfLeft, pfRight, pfTop, pfBottom must be valid, writable pointers.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::ComputeDistortion
functions.signature: virtual bool vr::IVRSystem::ComputeDistortion(vr::EVREye eEye, float fU, float fV, vr::DistortionCoordinates_t *pDistortionCoordinates) = 0
functions.description: Computes post-distortion UVs for each color channel for the specified eye at input UV in [0,1] space. Returns true on success. If false, output is not suitable.
requirements: eEye must be Eye_Left or Eye_Right.
fU and fV should be in [0,1] (inferred from comment).
pDistortionCoordinates must be a valid, writable pointer.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetEyeToHeadTransform
functions.description: Returns the transform from per-eye space to head space. Use to combine with head pose to produce correct per-eye views (Model * View * Eye^-1 * Projection).
requirements: eEye must be Eye_Left or Eye_Right.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetTimeSinceLastVsync
functions.description: Outputs seconds since last vsync and a frame counter. Returns false if no vsync time is available.
requirements: pfSecondsSinceLastVsync must be a valid, writable pointer.
pulFrameCounter must be a valid, writable pointer.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetD3D9AdapterIndex
functions.description: [D3D9] Returns the adapter index to pass to IDirect3D9::CreateDevice for fullscreen exclusive on the HMD, or -1 on error.
requirements: Caller should be using D3D9; otherwise value may not be meaningful (per comment).

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetDXGIOutputInfo
functions.description: [DX10/11] Outputs the adapter index (DXGI adapter) to create the device/swap chain on. On error, index is set to -1.
requirements: pnAdapterIndex must be a valid, writable pointer.
Caller should be using DX10/11; otherwise result may be irrelevant.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetOutputDevice
functions.signature: virtual void vr::IVRSystem::GetOutputDevice(uint64_t *pnDevice, vr::ETextureType textureType, VkInstance_T *pInstance = nullptr) = 0
functions.description: Returns a platform- and texture-type specific adapter/physical device identifier for creating textures/swap chains on the same GPU as the HMD. For D3D, returns adapter LUID; for Vulkan, returns VkPhysicalDevice via pInstance; for macOS, returns MTLDevice or renderer registryId depending on textureType. On error, device is set to 0.
requirements: pnDevice must be a valid, writable pointer.
textureType must match the API being used (e.g., TextureType_Vulkan requires a valid pInstance).
For Vulkan, pInstance must be a VkInstance with required extensions enabled (see IVRCompositor::GetVulkanInstanceExtensionsRequired).

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::IsDisplayOnDesktop
functions.description: Returns true if the HMD display is part of the desktop (extended mode) or false if hidden (direct mode).

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::SetDisplayVisibility
functions.description: Attempts to set HMD display visibility: true for extended (desktop) mode, false for direct mode. Returns true on success.
requirements: This may fail based on system/driver capabilities (returns false).

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetDeviceToAbsoluteTrackingPose
functions.signature: virtual void vr::IVRSystem::GetDeviceToAbsoluteTrackingPose(ETrackingUniverseOrigin eOrigin, float fPredictedSecondsToPhotonsFromNow, vr::TrackedDevicePose_t *pTrackedDevicePoseArray, uint32_t unTrackedDevicePoseArrayCount) = 0;
functions.description: Populates an array of predicted poses for all tracked devices, relative to the specified tracking origin, at a time offset from now. Typical use is once per frame just before rendering to get poses for prediction to the display time.
requirements: pTrackedDevicePoseArray must point to a writable buffer of unTrackedDevicePoseArrayCount elements.
unTrackedDevicePoseArrayCount must be <= vr::k_unMaxTrackedDeviceCount (64).
eOrigin selects the coordinate system; choose Seated, Standing, or RawAndUncalibrated as appropriate for the experience.
fPredictedSecondsToPhotonsFromNow is usually the time until photons hit the display; 0 yields poses at call time.
For devices with pose validity false, the pose should not be used for rendering.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetSeatedZeroPoseToStandingAbsoluteTrackingPose
functions.description: Returns the transform from the seated origin to the calibrated standing (absolute) tracking origin. Use to convert positions between seated and standing spaces.
requirements: No inputs; returns a 3x4 right‑handed transform matrix.
The returned transform may depend on user-configured chaperone/calibration data.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetRawZeroPoseToStandingAbsoluteTrackingPose
functions.description: Returns the transform from a device’s raw tracking origin to the calibrated standing absolute tracking origin. Use to convert raw driver space to calibrated space.
requirements: No inputs; returns a 3x4 matrix.
Intended for advanced uses; most apps should prefer seated/standing origins directly.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetSortedTrackedDeviceIndicesOfClass
functions.signature: virtual uint32_t vr::IVRSystem::GetSortedTrackedDeviceIndicesOfClass(ETrackedDeviceClass eTrackedDeviceClass, vr::TrackedDeviceIndex_t *punTrackedDeviceIndexArray, uint32_t unTrackedDeviceIndexArrayCount, vr::TrackedDeviceIndex_t unRelativeToTrackedDeviceIndex = vr::k_unTrackedDeviceIndex_Hmd) = 0;
functions.description: Retrieves device indices of a given class, sorted right-to-left relative to a reference device (default HMD). Returns the count or required size if the buffer is too small.
requirements: punTrackedDeviceIndexArray may be null to query required count; otherwise must point to a buffer of size unTrackedDeviceIndexArrayCount.
unTrackedDeviceIndexArrayCount is the capacity of the output array.
unRelativeToTrackedDeviceIndex may be vr::k_unTrackedDeviceIndex_Hmd or another valid tracked device index; use vr::k_unTrackedDeviceIndexInvalid only if documented; header defaults to HMD.
Return value > unTrackedDeviceIndexArrayCount indicates the buffer was too small.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetTrackedDeviceActivityLevel
functions.description: Returns the recent activity level (idle, user interaction, standby, etc.) for a tracked device.
requirements: unDeviceId must be a valid tracked device index (0..k_unMaxTrackedDeviceCount-1).

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::ApplyTransform
functions.signature: virtual void vr::IVRSystem::ApplyTransform(vr::TrackedDevicePose_t *pOutputPose, const vr::TrackedDevicePose_t *pTrackedDevicePose, const vr::HmdMatrix34_t *pTransform) = 0;
functions.description: Applies a rigid transform to a pose, correctly transforming position, orientation, linear and angular velocities into the new space.
requirements: pTrackedDevicePose must point to a valid input pose.
pTransform must point to a valid 3x4 transform matrix.
pOutputPose must be non-null and writable; it may alias pTrackedDevicePose if supported (not guaranteed).

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetTrackedDeviceIndexForControllerRole
functions.description: Deprecated. Returns the device index currently associated with a controller role (left/right hand). Prefer IVRInput.
requirements: unDeviceType should be LeftHand or RightHand; other roles may return invalid.
Return is vr::k_unTrackedDeviceIndexInvalid if none is assigned.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetControllerRoleForTrackedDeviceIndex
functions.description: Deprecated. Returns the controller role (e.g., left/right hand) for a given tracked device index. Prefer IVRInput.
requirements: unDeviceIndex must refer to a controller device; non-controllers may return TrackedControllerRole_Invalid.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetTrackedDeviceClass
functions.description: Returns the device class (HMD, Controller, Tracker, etc.) for a tracked device index, or Invalid if none is connected.
requirements: unDeviceIndex in range 0..k_unMaxTrackedDeviceCount-1.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::IsTrackedDeviceConnected
functions.description: Returns whether a device is currently connected in the given slot.
requirements: unDeviceIndex in range 0..k_unMaxTrackedDeviceCount-1.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetBoolTrackedDeviceProperty
functions.signature: virtual bool vr::IVRSystem::GetBoolTrackedDeviceProperty(vr::TrackedDeviceIndex_t unDeviceIndex, vr::ETrackedDeviceProperty prop, vr::ETrackedPropertyError *pError = 0L) = 0;
functions.description: Fetches a boolean property value for a tracked device. Returns false on error or if the property value is false.
requirements: unDeviceIndex must be a valid device.
prop must be a property of type Bool; otherwise pError will indicate TrackedProp_WrongDataType.
If pError is non-null, it will be set to a vr::ETrackedPropertyError result.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetFloatTrackedDeviceProperty
functions.signature: virtual float vr::IVRSystem::GetFloatTrackedDeviceProperty(vr::TrackedDeviceIndex_t unDeviceIndex, vr::ETrackedDeviceProperty prop, vr::ETrackedPropertyError *pError = 0L) = 0;
functions.description: Fetches a float property value for a tracked device. Returns 0 on error.
requirements: unDeviceIndex valid; prop must be a Float property.
Check pError for TrackedProp_Success before using non-zero values.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetInt32TrackedDeviceProperty
functions.signature: virtual int32_t vr::IVRSystem::GetInt32TrackedDeviceProperty(vr::TrackedDeviceIndex_t unDeviceIndex, vr::ETrackedDeviceProperty prop, vr::ETrackedPropertyError *pError = 0L) = 0;
functions.description: Fetches an int32 property for a tracked device. Returns 0 on error.
requirements: unDeviceIndex valid; prop must be an Int32 property.
Use pError to distinguish an actual 0 value from error.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetUint64TrackedDeviceProperty
functions.signature: virtual uint64_t vr::IVRSystem::GetUint64TrackedDeviceProperty(vr::TrackedDeviceIndex_t unDeviceIndex, vr::ETrackedDeviceProperty prop, vr::ETrackedPropertyError *pError = 0L) = 0;
functions.description: Fetches a uint64 property for a tracked device. Returns 0 on error.
requirements: unDeviceIndex valid; prop must be a Uint64 property.
Use pError for error details.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetMatrix34TrackedDeviceProperty
functions.signature: virtual vr::HmdMatrix34_t vr::IVRSystem::GetMatrix34TrackedDeviceProperty(vr::TrackedDeviceIndex_t unDeviceIndex, vr::ETrackedDeviceProperty prop, vr::ETrackedPropertyError *pError = 0L) = 0;
functions.description: Fetches a 3x4 matrix property for a tracked device. Returns identity on error.
requirements: unDeviceIndex valid; prop must be a Matrix34 property.
Check pError to verify success.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetArrayTrackedDeviceProperty
functions.signature: virtual uint32_t vr::IVRSystem::GetArrayTrackedDeviceProperty(vr::TrackedDeviceIndex_t unDeviceIndex, vr::ETrackedDeviceProperty prop, vr::PropertyTypeTag_t propType, void *pBuffer, uint32_t unBufferSize, vr::ETrackedPropertyError *pError = 0L) = 0;
functions.description: Fetches a property that is an array of a given type. Returns required size in bytes. If pBuffer is non-null and large enough, fills it with the array contents and returns the size used.
requirements: prop must be a single value or array of the specified propType or call will return 0 and set appropriate error.
pBuffer may be NULL to query the required size; otherwise it must point to a buffer of at least unBufferSize bytes.
unDeviceIndex must be valid.
Use returned size to allocate correctly then call again to copy.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetStringTrackedDeviceProperty
functions.signature: virtual uint32_t vr::IVRSystem::GetStringTrackedDeviceProperty(vr::TrackedDeviceIndex_t unDeviceIndex, vr::ETrackedDeviceProperty prop, char *pchValue, uint32_t unBufferSize, vr::ETrackedPropertyError *pError = 0L) = 0;
functions.description: Fetches a string property. Returns the length in bytes required (including trailing NUL). If pchValue is large enough, writes the string and returns its length.
requirements: pchValue may be NULL to query required size; otherwise must have capacity unBufferSize bytes.
Strings fit in buffers up to k_unMaxPropertyStringSize.
unDeviceIndex valid; prop must be a String property.
Check pError for TrackedProp_BufferTooSmall and resize as needed.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetPropErrorNameFromEnum
functions.description: Returns an ASCII name string for a tracked property error enum value. Useful for logging.
requirements: Pass a valid vr::ETrackedPropertyError value.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::PollNextEvent
functions.description: Retrieves the next pending VR event from the system event queue, if any. Returns true if an event was written.
requirements: pEvent must point to writable memory of size uncbVREvent.
uncbVREvent must be sizeof(vr::VREvent_t).
Events read via this function do not include overlay-specific queues.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::PollNextEventWithPose
functions.signature: virtual bool vr::IVRSystem::PollNextEventWithPose(vr::ETrackingUniverseOrigin eOrigin, vr::VREvent_t *pEvent, uint32_t uncbVREvent, vr::TrackedDevicePose_t *pTrackedDevicePose) = 0;
functions.description: Retrieves the next pending VR event and also returns the pose of the associated device, relative to eOrigin, from the time the event occurred (older than now).
requirements: pEvent must be a buffer of sizeof(vr::VREvent_t).
pTrackedDevicePose must point to writable memory for a single pose; may be NULL if pose not needed.
eOrigin selects the tracking origin.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::PollNextEventWithPoseAndOverlays
functions.signature: virtual bool vr::IVRSystem::PollNextEventWithPoseAndOverlays(vr::ETrackingUniverseOrigin eOrigin, vr::VREvent_t *pEvent, uint32_t uncbVREvent, vr::TrackedDevicePose_t *pTrackedDevicePose, vr::VROverlayHandle_t *pulOverlayHandle) = 0;
functions.description: Retrieves the next pending event from both the system queue and any overlay event queues owned by this user, optionally returns pose and the target overlay handle if applicable.
requirements: pEvent buffer size must be sizeof(vr::VREvent_t).
pulOverlayHandle must be a valid pointer (cannot be NULL) to receive the overlay handle or k_ulOverlayHandleInvalid.
pTrackedDevicePose may be NULL if pose is not needed.
Do not also call PollNextEvent/WithPose in the same loop; they share a read pointer.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetEventTypeNameFromEnum
functions.description: Returns an ASCII name string for a VR event type enum value. Useful for diagnostics.
requirements: Pass a valid vr::EVREventType value.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetHiddenAreaMesh
functions.signature: virtual vr::HiddenAreaMesh_t vr::IVRSystem::GetHiddenAreaMesh(vr::EVREye eEye, vr::EHiddenAreaMeshType type = vr::k_eHiddenAreaMesh_Standard) = 0;
functions.description: Returns the hidden or visible area mesh for the HMD panel for an eye. Use to stencil out pixels that won’t be visible after lens distortion or to draw the visible mask.
requirements: Use with backface culling disabled when rendering the mesh.
If the HMD has no mesh, returned pVertexData is NULL and unTriangleCount is 0.
type selects Standard/Inverse/LineLoop behaviors as documented.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetControllerState
functions.signature: virtual bool vr::IVRSystem::GetControllerState(vr::TrackedDeviceIndex_t unControllerDeviceIndex, vr::VRControllerState_t *pControllerState, uint32_t unControllerStateSize) = 0;
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of IVRInput. Fills a structure with current button/touch/axis state for a controller. Returns false if device index invalid.
requirements: unControllerDeviceIndex must refer to a controller.
pControllerState must point to writable memory of size unControllerStateSize, which should be sizeof(vr::VRControllerState_t).

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetControllerStateWithPose
functions.signature: virtual bool vr::IVRSystem::GetControllerStateWithPose(vr::ETrackingUniverseOrigin eOrigin, vr::TrackedDeviceIndex_t unControllerDeviceIndex, vr::VRControllerState_t *pControllerState, uint32_t unControllerStateSize, vr::TrackedDevicePose_t *pTrackedDevicePose) = 0;
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of IVRInput. Fills controller state and also returns the controller’s pose when that state was most recently updated.
requirements: eOrigin selects the tracking origin for the returned pose.
unControllerDeviceIndex must refer to a controller.
pControllerState must be a writable buffer sized to sizeof(VRControllerState_t).
pTrackedDevicePose must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::TriggerHapticPulse
functions.signature: virtual void vr::IVRSystem::TriggerHapticPulse(vr::TrackedDeviceIndex_t unControllerDeviceIndex, uint32_t unAxisId, unsigned short usDurationMicroSec) = 0;
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of IVRInput. Triggers a short haptic pulse on a controller axis, with a minimum enforced gap (≈5ms) between pulses on the same axis.
requirements: unControllerDeviceIndex must be a controller index.
unAxisId selects the haptic axis as defined by the controller.
usDurationMicroSec is the pulse duration in microseconds; hardware may clamp.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetButtonIdNameFromEnum
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of IVRInput. Returns the name string for a legacy button id.
requirements: Pass a valid EVRButtonId.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::GetControllerAxisTypeNameFromEnum
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of IVRInput. Returns the name string for a controller axis type.
requirements: Pass a valid EVRControllerAxisType.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::IsInputAvailable
functions.description: Returns whether the application is currently receiving input from the system (not preempted by system UI, etc.).
requirements: None.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::IsSteamVRDrawingControllers
functions.description: Returns true if SteamVR is drawing controllers on top of the application. Apps may choose not to render their own hands/controllers in this case.
requirements: None.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::ShouldApplicationPause
functions.description: Returns true if the user has put SteamVR into a mode distracting from the application; appropriate for pausing gameplay.
requirements: None.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::ShouldApplicationReduceRenderingWork
functions.description: Returns true if SteamVR is doing significant rendering work; apps can reduce workload (e.g., smaller render target).
requirements: None.

functions.name: vr::IVRSystem::PerformFirmwareUpdate
functions.description: Initiates a firmware update for a device (if applicable). On success, events VREvent_FirmwareUpdateStarted and VREvent_FirmwareUpdateFinished will be sent.
